items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I never knew him, but I used to hear fest

ctx.x: accordion? Can you remember any others? What about piccolo?

Piccolo. We didn't have that. Very few people could play piccolo over there. Who were there? Who were the ones who could? Let me see which one I could think of playing piccolo. I can't think of who I could play that piccolo. I know I've seen some played already. I knew just like I've seen some played here. You never worked with Bab Frank? I'm glad you mentioned his name. I knew I had played with piccolo already. Yeah, Bab Frank. That's a little bit of sort of a red looking color. I never knew him, but I used to…
when I ever talk about him playing, beating all the guys. Did he play in dance bands?
